conservative.read: This conservative plan targets around 1.5% per month, focusing on capital preservation and low drawdown. It significantly reduces leverage and concentration, aiming for steady, low-volatility returns. Expect minimal downside risk but also limited upside potential.

balanced.read: This balanced plan targets around 2.5% per month, aiming for risk-first growth. It reduces leverage and concentration while blending broad index exposure with quality tech. Expect moderate risk and potential for solid returns.
